findings.what: Public rate-limit key derives from client-supplied x-forwarded-for (spoofable) and limiter is in-process only (rate-limit.ts:6)
PRD §8.1 specifies Schedule-X resource view for doctor/reception schedule grid; a custom grid is used instead
Appointments booked <24h ahead have reminder_at in the past and get a 'reminder' immediately on next sweep instead of being skipped/handled explicitly
On failed cancel POST the one-time token is re-placed in the redirect query string, exposing it to logs/history
Emergency override bypasses the future-time check, allowing staff to create 'booked' appointments in the past without warning
